name: To Go Gently
source:
Pascal Moon is going to die. It's how they wanted to go, on their terms, but they don't want to be alone. They've said their goodbyes to their family and friends, and wait for their last rest to take them. Alongside them on this last journey is their trusted therapist Dr. Chariot. All that's left is one last conversation as Pascal drifts off.

[From [url=https://peppekz.itch.io/togogently]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
帕斯卡·穆恩快要死了。这就是他们想要的方式，按照他们的意愿，但他们不想孤单。他们已经向家人和朋友道别，等待最后的休息。在这最后的旅程中，与他们并肩作战的是他们值得信赖的治疗师Chariot博士。剩下的就是帕斯卡渐渐入睡时的最后一次谈话。

[来自[url=https://peppekz.itch.io/togogently]itch.io[/url]]
